## Learning Objectives

By the end of this chapter, you will be able to:

- Work with geospatial data types (Point, Line, Polygon)
- Perform spatial operations and distance calculations
- Execute spatial joins and geometric operations
- Handle coordinate systems and projections

This chapter explores geospatial data analysis capabilities in Ibis, including working
with geometric data types and spatial operations.

## Introduction

Geospatial data analysis is increasingly important in many domains, from urban planning
to logistics to environmental science. Ibis provides support for geospatial operations
through various backends that support spatial data types and functions.
